task.sonnet_answer: The 2026 U.S. Women's Open is scheduled to be held at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, California. Riviera Country Club is historically associated with Ben Hogan, who won there multiple times and gave the course its nickname 'Hogan's Alley.'

answer: FINAL: Nelly Korda was the key figure associated with the 2026 U.S. Women's Open held in California—she won the tournament at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, capturing her fourth major title and second consecutive victory in a major championship.

[2026 U.S. Women's Open] The 2026 U.S. Women's Open presented by Ally was the 81st U.S. Women's Open, held June 4–7 at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, California. Nelly Korda won her fourth major title (and second consecutive), one stroke ahead of runners-up Charley Hull and Gaby López.
